definitions: Astra is a genus of flowering plants in the family Malvaceae.
Astra is a character in Greek mythology, the goddess of justice.
Astra is a series of small family cars produced by Opel.
Astra is a private American aerospace company.
examples: The Astra plant has beautiful white flowers.
Astra is often depicted with a set of scales.
My first car was an Opel Astra.
Astra Space launched its rocket from Kodiak.
